Training archive policy for the fictional Elm classroom.
Exported practice files are retained for fourteen days.
Personal scratch notes are deleted after seven days.
A mentor may request a practice-file extension before the fourteen-day deadline.
This policy does not specify encryption keys, server ports or student passwords.
This is an isolated evaluation document, not an APplus course instruction.
